entries.og_description: Your Property. Your Interests. Fully Represented. Buying real estate in Bali? Don’t go in blind. Our Buyer’s Agent service is designed for serious investors and lifestyle buyers who want expert guidance, insider access, and full protection throughout the purchase process. Unlike traditional agents who represent sellers, we work for you— the buyer. From uncovering off-market gems to avoiding overpriced listings and risky developers, we ensure you make the right move in a complex market. WHO IS THIS FOR? International buyers investing in Bali for the first time. Expats relocating and looking for a long-term home. Entrepreneurs and digital nomads planning a base in paradise. WHAT’S INCLUDED Our Buyer’s Agent service is a complete start-to-finish representation package: Stage What You Get Discovery Deep dive into your goals, budget, and timeline Property Access Curated listings + off-market options based on your criteria Due Diligence Legal and financial checks on developers, ownership structures, and licenses Negotiation We negotiate price and terms on your behalf — with no conflict of interest Deal Structuring Advice on Freehold, Leasehold, PMA, and Joint Ventures Closing Support We support the entire legal process through to handover Post-Purchase Advisory Access to our trusted ecosystem: visa agents, contractors, tax advisors, property managers DIFFERENCE: BUYER AGENT VS SALES AGENT Feature Buyer’s Agent Sales Agent Works for You (the buyer) Seller or Developer Gets paid by You (via service fee or commission share) Developer or Property Owner Focus Protecting your goals & interests Selling the listed inventory Access to properties Full market + off-market access Limited to internal/exclusive listings Legal advice Guides you through ownership structures Often avoids this topic Negotiation role Negotiates for you May negotiate against you to protect the seller price Loyalty 100% to the buyer 100% to the listing WHAT’S INCLUDED Discovery and Goal Alignment We start with a l-on-1 call to understand your investment or lifestyle goals, preferred areas, timeline, and risk appetite. Property Sourcing We curate a list of vetted listings and off-market opportunities based on your brief — including developer direct options and hidden gems. Legal and Ownership Due Diligence We guide you on the right ownership model (Leasehold, Freehold, PMA, JV), and coordinate with trusted legal partners to verify every deal. Negotiation Support We negotiate on your behalf — aiming for price drops, better payment terms, and smart deal structure. All developer discounts go to you. Deal Structuring We advise on the safest structure for you: asset protection, long-term hold, or fast resale potential. Closing and Post-Sale Support We walk you through closing, handover, and optional services: property management, renovations, taxation, and relocation. WE DON’T UPSELL. WE DON’T SUGARCOAT. WE ONLY RECOMMEND WHAT WE’D BUY OURSELVES. Let’s make your Bali property purchase the right move — not a risky one. GET ASSISTANCE

entries.seo_title: Frequently Asked Questions | 8 Degree
entries.h1: Frequently Asked Questions
entries.og_title: Frequently Asked Questions | 8 Degree
entries.og_description: Frequently Asked Questions Common questions asked about real estate in Bali. Here are some important questions that are frequently asked and the answers to the questions. Didn’t find the answer you’re looking for? Feel free to reach out to our team. We’ll be happy to help answer your questions and guide you through the process. Speak with our advisor Can foreigners buy property in Bali? Yes, through the correct legal structure. Most buyers use leasehold or a PT PMA setup, depending on the goal. What’s the difference between leasehold and freehold? Freehold is full ownership and typically for Indonesian citizens. Leasehold gives you long-term rights to use the property for an agreed period. Do I need to be in Bali to buy? No, you can view properties remotely and sign via legal authorization if needed. What is the buying process? You choose a property, we run due diligence, then proceed with deposit, contract signing, and handover through a notary. What fees should I expect on top of the price? Usually notary, legal checks, and taxes. We will provide a full breakdown before you commit. Can I rent the property out? Yes. Many buyers combine personal use and rental income. Professional management can handle everything end-to-end. Is Bali property a good investment? It can be, if the location, build quality, and legal structure are right. We give realistic numbers based on the current market. Is it better to buy off-plan or ready? Ready units can generate rental income immediately.Off-plan can offer a better entry price, if you plan to flip later. Can I get a mortgage as a foreigner? Most purchases are cash or developer installments. Financing options for foreigners are limited. How do I choose the right area? It depends on your goal: lifestyle, rental yield, or long-term growth. We match areas to your plan. How do I know a listing is safe? We verify zoning, permits, ownership documents, and contract terms before you move forward. How do I get started? Send your budget, preferred area, and timeline. We’ll send curated options and a clear next-step plan.
